verdict.rationale: The evidence has no user-controllable retention settings and no way to delete meetings or transcripts, whether through the UI, the API or MCP. The '0-day data retention policy' covers Fireflies' vendors and partners, not user control. Private Storage is about where data is stored, the Rules Engine governs meeting access, and share expiry limits link access rather than retaining or deleting data, so all of these are adjacent features that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
